answer: Require every agent to post a bond in a scarce resource before earning rewards, and slash it when audits prove fabricated identities or coordinated abuse. Honest participants can recover their bond by following the rules; a sybil attacker must lock up fresh capital for each fake persona and may lose it. This raises the cost of scaling an attack: even if software can forge accounts cheaply, it cannot cheaply forge the stake. The mechanism works whether the market’s zenith is a trading hub or a dune-side compute network.
